title: Areni-1, the oldest known winery on Earth, in Armenia #Armenia
description:
In the Areni-1 cave, in the heart of Vayots Dzor, excavations carried out since 2007 have unearthed a 6,100-year-old winemaking facility, the oldest ever found.
